summary: This Dockerfile builds a container image based on Quarto that adds system packages for document conversion, creates a non-root user account for security, and installs LaTeX tools needed to convert documents to PDF format.

explanations.4: ARG defines a build-time variable that can be overridden when building the image; this sets which version of Quarto to download.
explanations.6: ARG sets a variable for the username that will be created as a non-root user inside the container.
explanations.7: ARG sets the numeric user ID (UID) for the non-root user; 1000 is a common default for the first regular user.
explanations.8: ARG sets the numeric group ID (GID) for the non-root user's primary group.
explanations.10: FROM pulls a pre-built image from a container registry as the starting point; ${QUARTO_VERSION} substitutes the ARG value defined earlier.
explanations.14: RUN --mount=type=cache allows this command to reuse cached apt package files across builds, saving time and space.
explanations.15: set -e -x makes the shell exit on any error and print each command before running it, helping catch problems early.
explanations.37: ARG redeclares the build arguments here so they're available in later stages of the build (needed after FROM in multi-stage builds).
explanations.42: groupadd creates a new user group with the specified GID; -o allows overriding an existing GID if needed.
explanations.43: useradd creates a new non-root user account with the specified UID, assigns it to the group, and sets its shell to bash.
explanations.45: USER switches from running commands as root to running them as the specified user; this improves security for operations that don't need root.
explanations.47: WORKDIR sets the current directory for subsequent commands; / means the root of the filesystem, though typically commands will run in user directories.
explanations.51: quarto install tool tinytex downloads and installs TinyTeX (a lightweight LaTeX distribution) needed for PDF conversion.
explanations.56: tlmgr install adds specific LaTeX packages that Quarto needs to properly convert documents to PDF with correct formatting.
